## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix `requirement_proven` before merge: for an empty criteria list it now returns `True`, which contradicts the "no behavior change" stated in the PR description and marks requirements with no criteria as proven.

## Changes
The PR replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` in 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files and in `h091_requirements.py`. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum against the length, and adds a top-level `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:11 — correctness — Return False again when criteria is empty — When `criteria=[]`, `sum(...)` is 0 and `len(criteria)` is 0, so `proven == len(criteria)` returns `True`. The removed code returned `bool(criteria) and all(...)`, which gave `False`. The warning on line 10 is logged, but execution then continues and reports success. — A requirement with no criteria now passes release review as proven, which reverses the gate's prior outcome. — Fix: Restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)`, and extend `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py` with an empty-list case.
